newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: EU gives Ethiopia $460 million in loans, grants.
newsitem.headline: EU gives Ethiopia $460 million in loans, grants.

text.p: The European Union signed an agreement on Monday giving Ethiopia $460 million in grants and development loans, a joint statement said.

A total of $370 million would be allocated as grants under the Lome IV Convention between the EU and African, Caribbean and Pacific (ACP) countries to support food security, human development, road projects, democratisation and institution building, it said.
The remaining $90 million is a loan from the European Investment Bank (EIB) to finance investment projects in industry, tourism, mining and energy, transport and telecommunications.
The agreement was signed by Ethiopia's minister of Economic Development and Cooperation Girma Biru and Joao de Deus Pinheiro, the visiting EU Commissioner.
It is aimed "at supporting Ethiopia's efforts to achieve comprehensive self-reliant and self-sustained socio-economic development," the statement said.
Girma expressed appreciation and gratitude to the EU assistance which he said will be earmarked for priorites in Ethiopia's five-year development plan.
